estimates.assumptions: 25 g butter; pure fat, no carbohydrates
8 thin slices white bread (~320 g total, crusts removed but weight includes edible portion only); using ~47.5 g carbs and ~2.4 g fiber per 100 g white bread
50 g sultanas (raisins); standard dried fruit values
2 tsp ground cinnamon (~5 g); modest seasoning amount
350 ml whole cow's milk; ~4.8 g carbs per 100 ml
50 ml double (heavy) cream; ~4 g carbs per 100 ml
2 large free-range eggs (~100 g without shell); trace carbs from ~0.4 g per large egg
nutmeg to taste; negligible and unquantified, cannot reasonably estimate
